signs.Aries: You may feel as though you are being ignored on purpose. You are to an extent, but only because your partner (current or prospective) is taking time out to get some much-needed space. They want to make the relationship between you work even better and are taking time to attend to their own issues so that they can give to you more fully and freely. Don't interfere.
signs.Taurus: You'll be provided with a great opportunity to take time out to talk with your romantic partner. You may have both been busy lately, with different and very pressing issues to attend to. You may both be feeling out of joint because of the different demands of life. Whatever the reason, you now have a chance to sit down and share your thoughts and feelings with each other on anything and everything.
signs.Gemini: Small gatherings of friends and families may provide the opportunity for you to meet someone rather special. However, your first encounter may be much more serious than you hoped or feel comfortable about. But though you may begin your relationship with a very thought-provoking, possibly disturbing conversation, where this eventually leads will certainly make you smile. So, don't be put off in the meantime.
signs.Cancer: Try and get to know that special person. You may have thought about abandoning the whole idea of ever speaking, as they always seem so distant and aloof. But today your determination is renewed. You are going to find out what makes them tick and will not give up until you have solved this enigmatic mystery.
signs.Leo: A loved one seems very difficult to comprehend at the moment. Don't let this worry you. Don't feel abandoned, or as though your relationship has been given the kiss of death; you just need some time and space to think a few things through and will be back in top form sooner than you think.
signs.Virgo: Something's going to make you a very happy person today. You have long desired that a special person in your life would make a firmer commitment to you. Now it seems that this is precisely what they intend. You will find that although they often seem very quiet and reflective, once they give their word, they will do their utmost to keep it.
signs.Libra: You may find love and love affairs hard going today. A certain ambivalence on the part of your partner (current or prospective) is likely today. You cannot seem to break through a barrier, and it is causing a great deal of distress. Don't worry too much; your friend just needs time and space to come to a few conclusions. Pretty soon you will find that your friend is anything but diffident.
signs.Scorpio: A sense of light relief and much laughter will wash over your current relationship today. If you have both been burdened by troubles connected with other issues in your lives, then take time to reconnect, and to bond with each other more deeply. Watch a funny movie and just have fun. You both deserve it!
signs.Sagittarius: Good humor and a need to see the funny side of your relationship characterize your love life today. You'll both feel the need to take a more liberal view of each other. Allow each other the space to be totally yourselves and open up to the genuine warmth you both share, especially if things aren't going as well as they could.
signs.Capricorn: You and a loved one are becoming closer together in a warm and particularly caring way. Perhaps you have both been overworked lately and have not had an opportunity to relax and allow a sense of calm cheerfulness to humor you. Adopting a positive perspective that allows for a sense of humor will work wonders. Be kind to each other today!
signs.Aquarius: You can have a ball today. Doing something fun together with your sweetheart will do you both a great deal of good. You need to get out and talk to new and different people, if possible, so try moving in some new social circles and broadening your outlook and horizon. Take a risk and move into the unknown. Pretty soon you will have some great new friends.
signs.Pisces: Spend time with your love interest. If your latest liaison is not only a secret, but also a dangerous enterprise, then you may feel even more moved to take a gamble. Maybe you would like to take them out and show them off. Life and love are a continuing succession of changes and risks - perhaps yours will pay off today!
